<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Sales" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="manager" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>select</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>tell</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="assistant" name="Sales Assistant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>call</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>note</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Open leads available" />
    <bpmn:task id="check" name="Check the open leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="select" name="Select the top five leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="tell" name="Tell the Sales Assistant to call the contact person of the leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="call" name="Call the customer" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="interested" name="Someone interested?" />
    <bpmn:task id="note" name="Send a note to the Manager" />
    <bpmn:task id="process" name="Process the lead" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Lead processed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="check" targetRef="select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="select" targetRef="tell" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="tell" targetRef="call" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="call" targetRef="interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="yes" sourceRef="interested" targetRef="note" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="no, call the next customer" sourceRef="interested" targetRef="call" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="note" targetRef="process" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="process" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
